key_points: P&G announced an additional $10 bn in dividends despite a $1.4 bn cost increase, signaling confidence but raising payout‑ratio concerns
Oral‑B iO technology received top ranking in a large independent analysis, supporting the strength of the oral‑care franchise
P&G joined a consortium with Nestlé, PepsiCo, Colgate‑Palmolive and others on paper‑flexible, recyclable packaging – a long‑term ESG play with limited near‑term pricing impact
Mixed commentary on growth: Jim Cramer’s criticism and Zacks note competitive pressure in Fabric & Home Care offset by early signs of Tide innovation momentum
Institutional activity: BofA increased its stake while CalSTRS trimmed exposure, suggesting a nuanced view among large investors
